rules.if: change does not alter any evidence applicability basis for proposition
change alters a relied-upon physical/context basis and current evidence has not yet re-established applicability
required reassessment evidence is absent or insufficient after materiality is established
new evidence specifically satisfies the current evidence requirement for a proposition
rules.then: that proposition may return to SUPPORTABLE
do not automatically restore descendants; evaluate each descendant's own current requirements

rules.if: historical evidence was valid at T0 and later context changes
rules.then: preserve T0 historical standing; do not rewrite it retroactively

rules.if: all monitored values are within limits but representativeness is not established
rules.then: do not infer current environmental qualification from in-limit values alone
